subject.title: improve: index transcript mirror persistence checks

question: Should the Plugin SDK permanently expose these three transcript write-lock facts for Codex and Copilot mirror implementations?
rationale: The branch changes a documented plugin-facing contract, not merely a private performance implementation; repository policy treats new Plugin SDK APIs as compatibility-sensitive and requires maintainer-visible direction.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK contract
options.body: Keep the three typed facts public, document their semantics and ownership, and require fresh current-head proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the optimization owner-internal
options.body: Move the fact probes behind an internal bundled-mirror seam if no supported external plugin needs this contract.

options.title: Pause for broader SDK design
options.body: Defer the follow-up if the write-lock API should be designed alongside other transcript persistence capabilities.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the three typed facts public, document their semantics and ownership, and require fresh current-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged transcript foundation and this direct follow-up, so they are best positioned to explain the intended contract boundary to the deciding maintainer.
